claims.statement: Backend integration tests under backend/tests/integration/ drive a live API over HTTP (not a *_test.go file but a main package with an APIClient), exercise the full stack through MySQL/Redis/asynq, and provide clock helpers (SetServerTime, AdvanceServerTime, ResetServerTime) that move the server's internal clock without waiting on wall-clock time.

Frontend E2E coverage under frontend/tests/e2e/ uses Playwright with Page Object Model classes (frontend/tests/page-objects/) and must exercise every Admin and Partner route at desktop and mobile widths, including 390px and 320px, with tests designed to fail when a workflow disappears from either view.

Property-based tests in backend/internal/domain/ use github.com/leanovate/gopter to fuzz invariants across login_event, audit_log, and event_factory families; GORM transaction tests use sqlite in-memory, and cache tests use miniredis, keeping unit tests hermetic without mocks at the HTTP boundary.
